Sara — thanks for the quick questions. High level answers up front and then a suggested plan: 

- Routing: We support both sequential and parallel signing. For liability/order reasons we recommend sequential when there are approval-dependent fields (e.g., billing contact updates) — sounds like CFO -> VP Ops is fine as sequential.
- Authorization: a POA is not required; an authorized signatory listed in the corporate signature block (name/title/email) is sufficient. If you prefer, a short confirmation email from your GC will also satisfy our internal audit.
- Audit log & clean PDF: we will provide the full DocuSign audit trail and a signed clean PDF immediately after completion and will upload to the shared Drive.
- Witness/notary: not required for the Order Form in typical SaaS deals; if your GC insists we can accommodate an additional witness step (it will add time).

Suggested next steps (what we'll do from Redwood):
1) I will create a DocuSign envelope configured for sequential routing: Jon Smith (CFO) -> Dana Reyes (VP Ops).
2) Attach the redlined MSA (Synergetix-MSA-v3-redlines.pdf) and the final order form draft.
3) Include a short signer instructions section (actions expected and where to initial).
4) After execution we will upload executed PDFs and the audit log and drop links in this thread.

Can you confirm signers and preferred emails, and whether the CFO will be able to sign during business hours (we can set a 14-day expiry but prefer to keep window open for scheduling)?
